subject: Panel upgrade + new circuits for restaurant kitchen
body_text: We are renovating our restaurant kitchen and need a 400A panel upgrade, 8 new dedicated circuits, and hood interlock wiring. Site: Rivertown Grill, 300 Warburton Ave, Yonkers NY 10701, Westchester County. Commercial building. Plans available. GM Sandra Perez 914-555-0150.
